title: God Files Refactor Phase 2 - Story Development API Package Split
goal: Convert app/api/story_development.py into a package, move inline API request and response models into schema modules, and split route families into thin domain routers without changing any route behavior or paths.

global_context.existing_capability_lock: Do not add new route families, request fields, response fields, or status code behavior.

tasks.title: Add failing tests for API package conversion and schema extraction surfaces
tasks.objective: Create tests that fail until app.api.story_development becomes a package and the schema modules exist.
repo_context: Current imports use app.api.story_development as a single module with build_story_development_router.
The target package must still expose build_story_development_router from app.api.story_development.

Schema targets are app/schemas/story_development_api/common.py, flow.py, brainstorm.py, braindump.py, foundation.py, characters.py, world_bible.py, arcs.py, branches.py, review.py, planning.py, drafting.py, and storyboard.py.
implementation_notes: Assert build_story_development_router remains importable from app.api.story_development.
Assert the named schema modules import successfully.
Assert the named route modules import successfully.

verification.expected_red: FAIL until the package and schema modules are created

guardrails: Do not add tests for routes that do not already exist.
Do not encode new behavior expectations.
tasks.review_before_complete: Confirm the tests lock package structure and compatibility only.

tasks.title: Convert the story development router module into a package facade
tasks.objective: Convert app/api/story_development.py into app/api/story_development/__init__.py while preserving build_story_development_router and current route registration behavior.
repo_context: This is the API package conversion seam, analogous to the persistence package conversion.
The package facade must continue exposing build_story_development_router for all existing tests and import sites.
implementation_notes: Move the existing router implementation into the package entrypoint as a temporary facade.
Do not split route families yet beyond what is necessary for the package import target to work.

expected_green: existing story development API regression tests still pass

guardrails: Do not move inline schemas in this task.
tasks.review_before_complete: Review the package facade and confirm it remains a compatibility layer only.

tasks.title: Create story development API schema modules and move inline request or response models into them
tasks.objective: Create the schema package and move inline StrictModel classes out of the router file without changing field names or validation behavior.
repo_context: The current router contains list response wrappers, request models, and PATCH payload models inline.
The design spec requires these to move into domain-specific schema files under app/schemas/story_development_api/.
implementation_notes: Use common.py for shared wrappers only and create the domain modules named in the design spec.
Keep existing snake_case field names and StrictModel inheritance.
Do not rename request or response classes unless the old names are preserved by imports.
guardrails: Do not add or remove fields.
Do not move business logic into schema files.
tasks.review_before_complete: Compare each moved model against the original inline definition and verify field parity.

tasks.title: Create coordination-only API dependency helpers
tasks.objective: Create a dependencies module that exposes service accessors and shared dependency helpers only.
repo_context: The design spec explicitly forbids response projection, PATCH merge logic, and route-family business rules in dependencies.py.
This module is allowed to own service accessors and auth or context extraction only.
implementation_notes: Move only shared dependency helpers into this file.
Do not move route-family transformation logic here.
Keep the module small and purpose-limited.

verification.expected_green: isolated route-family API tests still pass

guardrails: No PATCH merge logic in dependencies.py.
No response shaping utilities in dependencies.py.
tasks.review_before_complete: Read the whole file and confirm it is coordination-only.

tasks.title: Split story development routes into domain router modules
tasks.objective: Use planning.py as the first router extraction anchor, then create the other route-family modules named in the design spec and register them through router.py.
repo_context: Target route modules are flow.py, brainstorm.py, braindump.py, foundation.py, characters.py, world_bible.py, arcs.py, branches.py, review.py, planning.py, drafting.py, and storyboard.py.
Each route file may own HTTP parsing, response codes, and response shaping only.
Cross-family business rules belong in services, not routers.
implementation_notes: Create router.py as the central registration-only module.
Extract route families one by one, preserving current operations and tags.
Keep build_story_development_router as the compatibility entrypoint.

expected_green: all targeted API route-family tests pass
full story development integration flow passes

guardrails: Do not change operation names checked in audit logging.
Do not add new routers or route prefixes.
Do not move service logic into route modules.
tasks.review_before_complete: Check every new route module and confirm it is thin and domain-local.
